no-priors.name: No Priors
no-priors.bio: Podcast: Amex Global Business Travel: The World’s First AI Take Private with Long Lake CEO Alexander Taubman

html_en:
The evolution from text to vision in AI output design and the first AI-driven private equity takeover mark a pivotal moment in how we interact with artificial intelligence and deploy it in traditional industries.

The Visual Future of AI Output

Andrej Karpathy offered a fascinating glimpse into the future of human-AI interaction this week, arguing that while audio may be our preferred input method, vision will dominate AI output. His observations cut to the heart of how we'll communicate with machines:
"This works really well btw, at the end of your query ask your LLM to 'structure your response as HTML', then view the generated file in your browser. I've also had some success asking the LLM to present its output as slideshows, etc."
Karpathy's broader vision is compelling: "Around a ~third of our brains are a massively parallel processor dedicated to vision, it is the 10-lane superhighway of information into brain." He sees a clear progression from raw text to markdown to HTML, ultimately reaching "interactive neural videos/simulations" generated by diffusion models. The implications extend beyond mere presentation. As @swyx noted in his reaction to new real-time AI capabilities, "everyone's definition of 'realtime' just got a massive frciking upgrade." We're witnessing a fundamental shift in how quickly and richly AI can respond to human needs.

The First AI Take Private

Perhaps the most significant business development comes from Long Lake Management's $6.3 billion acquisition of American Express Global Business Travel — what appears to be the world's first AI-focused private equity takeover. CEO Alexander Taubman outlined their compelling thesis on the No Priors podcast:
"We've taken an approach since the beginning of investing very heavily in our horizontal AI platform, we call Nexus. I'd say roughly 80% of the infrastructure is shared across the verticals, and then there's a lot of work to take it and deploy it into those end markets."
What's remarkable about Long Lake's approach is their focus on growth over cost-cutting. Taubman emphasized:
"Our view of AI is it's incredibly positive sum. I know this is a little bit of a narrative violation, but we actually think AI makes people more productive. And we have more productive people. You want more of them."
The results speak for themselves. Companies that were growing 0-5% annually before acquisition are now growing 20%+ under their AI-enhanced operations. This isn't just efficiency—it's transformation.

Developer Tools Get Personal

Anthropic continues refining the developer experience with Claude, as @_catwu demonstrated with their new terminal control plane. The ability to run `claude agents` for a control plane in your terminal represents another step toward seamless AI integration in everyday workflows. Meanwhile, Amanda Askell added a surprisingly human touch by creating an audiobook version of Claude's constitution, noting plans to "add the option of listening to it on fast mode." It's a small but telling example of how AI companies are thinking about accessibility and user experience.
The thread connecting these developments is clear: AI is moving from a technology we use to one we live with. Whether through richer visual outputs, transformed business operations, or more intuitive developer tools, the integration is accelerating. Karpathy's vision of interactive neural interfaces may still be years away, but the foundation is being laid in HTML responses, AI-driven acquisitions, and terminal control planes today.
html_zh:
当AI从文本输出进化到视觉体验，而企业开始通过AI驱动的收购重塑传统行业时，我们正站在人机交互革命的关键节点。

视觉优先的AI交互革命

Andrej Karpathy 分享了一个令人兴奋的发现，揭示了AI输出方式的重要演变。他建议用户在查询结尾添加"将你的回复结构化为HTML"，然后在浏览器中查看生成的文件。

"更广泛地说，我认为音频是人类向AI输入信息的首选方式，但视觉（图像/动画/视频）是AI向人类输出信息的首选方式。我们大脑约三分之一是专门用于视觉的大规模并行处理器，这是信息进入大脑的10车道超级高速公路。"

Karpathy预测AI输出将经历一个渐进式发展：从原始文本（阅读困难）到markdown（当前默认），再到HTML（早期但正成为新的良好默认选择），最终达到由扩散神经网络直接生成的交互式视频/模拟。

这一观察揭示了一个深刻的洞察：随着AI能力的提升，我们需要重新思考人机交互的基本模式。输入端音频优化，输出端视觉增强，将创造更加直观和高效的沟通方式。

实时AI的新标杆

swyx 对最新的实时AI发展表示兴奋，他评论道："我相信孩子们会说这是'@thinkymachines刚刚残酷地框架化了gdm和oai'。基本上每个人对'实时'的定义刚刚得到了大规模升级。"

这种对实时AI能力突破的反应表明，行业对响应速度和交互质量的期望正在快速提升。当新技术重新定义"实时"标准时，整个生态系统都必须适应这些新的基准。

开发工具的人性化进步

开发者体验正在获得重要改进。Cat Wu 介绍了Claude代理的新功能，她分享道："运行`claude agents`在你的终端中获得控制平面！之后，从任何cli会话按`<-`将其注册到控制平面。"

同时，Amanda Askell 宣布了Claude宪章的有声书版本，表示："现在你可以听我和Joe朗读Claude的宪章作为有声书。正在努力添加快速模式的选项。"

这些改进反映出AI公司越来越注重用户体验的细节，从命令行工具到教育内容，都在朝着更加友好和可访问的方向发展。

AI驱动的企业收购新模式

在商业层面，我们见证了一种全新的投资模式的诞生。观看/收听：No Priors播客采访了Long Lake Management的CEO Alexander Taubman，他们刚刚宣布以63亿美元收购美国运通全球商务旅行，这被认为是"世界上第一次AI驱动的私有化收购"。

"我们采取的方法是从一开始就大量投资我们的水平AI平台，我们称之为Nexus。我想说大约80%的基础设施是跨垂直行业共享的，然后需要大量工作将其部署到这些终端市场。"

Taubman解释了他们如何通过AI平台快速转变收购的企业："现在在与一家公司合作的几天内，我们就能非常快速地部署这个平台并看到立即的影响。"更令人印象深刻的是增长数据——他们投资的企业通常年增长率为0-5%，现在实现了20%以上的增长。

"我们对AI的看法是它非常积极...我们实际上认为AI让人们更有生产力。当你有更高生产力的人时，你会想要更多这样的人。当你的客户更满意时，你增长得更快。"

从交互界面的视觉化革新到企业收购的AI化转型，今天的发展显示出人工智能正在深刻重塑我们工作、交流和商业运营的方式。这不仅仅是技术的进步，更是思维模式和商业逻辑的根本性变革。
